Action: Letpal(variable)

Related Actions: changecol, changeset, letset, letcatch
Related Events: col
See also: FKiSS, Events, Actions

letpal(variable)

First defined in: FKiSS3
The letpal action sets the value of variable to the current palette for the current set (page).

variable

variable must be a variable name.

Example:

;@ letpal(P) ; Set variable P to the number of the current palette.
